procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
ESP 57348 was represented by Anna Renteria.
GBR 57349 was represented by Sebastian Bailey.
Before the hearing began GBR 57349 took a 30% Post-Race Penalty in accordance with RRS T1(a).
facts: The conditions at the time of the incident in race 4 of U-17 white fleet were 18 knots of wind and 1,5m waves.
Before the start ESP 57348 and GBR 57349 were both sailing on starboard, with ESP 57438 to leeward of GBR 57349 at a lateral distance of 2 metres between the boats.
At the start GBR 57349 bore away reducing quickly the distance between the boats to 1 metre.
5 seconds after the start, contact occurred between ESP 57348´s crew and the jib of GBR 57349.
decision: The protest is upheld. Since GBR 57349 took an applicable penalty, she is not further penalized under RRS 60.5(c)(2).
Redress is not given to ESP 57348.
